name: knob-senses-knn
description: k-NN de regressao de PCA (potencia CA do inversor, kW) do knob-senses, gerado com emlearn. 1000 prototipos, k=1. Recebe grandezas brutas, quantiza em int16, normaliza internamente e devolve kW. ~7.8 KB de flash e ~7.8 KB de RAM no ESP32-S3.
keywords: knn, k-nearest-neighbors, emlearn, tinyml, machine-learning, regression, arduino, esp32
